review_score_bounds.name: review_score_bounds
review_score_bounds.value: ("review"."score1" IS NULL OR (typeof("review"."score1") = 'integer' AND "review"."score1" BETWEEN 1 AND 5)) AND ("review"."score2" IS NULL OR (typeof("review"."score2") = 'integer' AND "review"."score2" BETWEEN 1 AND 5)) AND ("review"."score3" IS NULL OR (typeof("review"."score3") = 'integer' AND "review"."score3" BETWEEN 1 AND 5))

review_complete_scores.name: review_complete_scores
review_complete_scores.value: "review"."completedAt" IS NULL OR ("review"."score1" IS NOT NULL AND "review"."score2" IS NOT NULL AND "review"."score3" IS NOT NULL)
